startup_mode.description: Startup-only execution: same fixture, argv and prompt as the full run, but ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points to an unroutable local port so no model request can leave the machine. Evidence = InstructionsLoaded hooks, the system/init event and the transcript's startup context records (instructions, skill_listing, agent_listing_delta, prompt_snapshot). Model behavior is NOT exercised.
